verdict.rationale: Conductor cloud workspaces are shared with the organization, so teammates can open the same workspace, follow the conversation and pick up the work. Workspaces are created from repos, branches, PRs, or GitHub and Linear issues. However, these workspaces are scoped to individual tasks, each with its own branch and working tree, rather than serving as a persistent team-wide source of truth, and nothing shows docs being ingested into them. Missing for 10: creating a workspace from documentation or knowledge sources, a persistent shared source-of-truth workspace rather than task-scoped ones, multi-repo aggregation, and independent corroboration.
